name: Causal Ordering
description: Operations carry causal metadata (vector clocks or hybrid logical clocks). Dependencies are explicit, enabling each device to determine which operations must be applied before others.
purpose: Enable distributed causal ordering so every device can determine the correct application order of concurrent and dependent operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Every operation carries causal metadata (vector clock or HLC timestamp).
Causal metadata is sufficient to reconstruct the happens-before relation.
Dependencies are made explicit in the operation payload.
Causally-dependent operations are never reordered by the transport or storage layer.
Devices reject or defer operations whose causal dependencies are not yet satisfied.
